page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with the scriptural references set in italic at the end of lines. No marginal notes. Heading-like number "XXXVII." on its own line, then one paragraph ending with the half word "confo-".

main_text.p: catorum fit unico actu & semel, Heb.10:2. 2. Est im-mutabilis juxta naturam Dei, cui repugnat peccata se-mel remissa iterum punire, ideo Paulo persuasum erat, neque mortem, neque vitam neque Ang: &c. Rom.8: 37.38.39. 3. Est perfecta, expers quoad se omnis in- & decrementi, Jes.43:5. Psalm.103:12. Non per ludum- & jocum, sed serio nobiscum agit Deus, remittens, id est non reputans, sed tegens peccata nostra, Psalm.32:1. Liturâm[?] enim gratiose chirographo nostro inducit, la-cerat & abjicit. 4. Etiam est certissima, si enim a-gnoscit bos possessorem suum & asinus praesepe Domini sui, Esai.1:3. quomodo genus electum, regale sacerdotium, gens sancta, populus quem sibi Deus ut pro-prium vendicat, virtutes illius non praedicabit, qui vocavit e tenebris in admirabilem suam lucem, 1.Petr.2:9. Purificat Deus sibi ipsi populum peculiarem, se-ctatorem bonorum operum, Tit.2:14. Qui per opera purificationis suae & electionis conscius: habens spem hanc in eo sitam, castum se conservat, sicut & ille castus est, 1.Joh.3:23. Rom.5:1. Eph.3:12. 1.Joh.3:14. Jac.1:6. Interna sp. s. testificatione, Rom.8:15. 1.Cor.2:12. 2.Cor.1:21. Gal.4:6. & aliis locis, inductione exemplorum. Abrah: Rom.4:11.16.18. Job.19:25. Pauli, Rom.8:38.

Coronodis loco apponam Satanae objectionem, aggravando & ob oculos ponendo nobis nostra innume-rabilia peccata, sed Resp. credere, id est, firmiter statuere, remissa esse nobis per Christum omnia peccata; quae consolatio est solius Ecclesiae; Num. 23: 25.26. page.notes: Liturâm: the word is uncertain, possibly with a circumflex or another mark over the a. Interna "sp. f." read as "sp. s." (long s printed as f). Two other possible misreadings: the printed text may have "Rom.8:15" or "Rom.8:16", and the reference "Job.19:25" is read as printed.
